as_told.title: Host's Peru documentary on three-fingered mummies

plain: A podcast host, Joe Rogan, says that "now we have three-fingered mummies in Peru." Another podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he has seen these beings in Peru himself, skeletons with three fingers, and dates them to somewhere between 800 and 1,700 years ago. If they are what these men suggest, they would be the remains of beings that weren't human.
